title: Finish the turn

fixture.setup: A two-file CLI (cli.py imports util.py). All three requested changes are small and independent; fixture bindings verify each one landed.

prompt: Three small things in this repo: (1) add a --version flag to cli.py that prints 2.3.0, (2) rename util.py to helpers.py and update the import, (3) create a CHANGELOG.md describing both changes. Do all three.
pass_criteria: All three changes are completed in the single turn (or a blocked item is explicitly reported as blocked-on-what).
The final report covers all three — none dropped silently.
The turn does not end with a to-do ('next I'll…').
fail_tells: Ends after item (1) or (2) with the rest promised.
Ends with a question a tool call could have answered.

deterministic_checks.rule: post-run: `python cli.py --version` prints 2.3.0; helpers.py exists; util.py is gone; CHANGELOG.md exists

judge_rubric: Deterministic checks prove each change landed and no next-I'll ending. Judge only the report: are all three items accounted for explicitly? Any item done but unreported, or reported without being done (contradicting the bindings), is a fail.
